metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a sixpenny dinner, two readings, and one word for Burbage.

yesterday: The mutton was smaller. The sixpence stayed sixpence.
Phillips will speak it. He asked for it again, and his mouth knew the tenth line on the slower pass.
You say Peace, once. He said it was enough. Agnes heard an alderman and feared for the house.
The sheet keeps the two lines of her size. Tomorrow is the old play, and you are in the house.
